headline: GREEN: Wk3 rebuilt around Monza HM Sunday, target 1:37-1:40
summary: HRV 77 (back from 55 Sunday), RHR 48, sleep 6.6h, CTL 48.1, ATL 52.1, TSB -4. Sunday was underdelivered: 50min trail at 113bpm, icu 23 vs 55 planned; today's 33min spin (icu 25) covers the gap. Week rebuilt: Tue HM-pace rehearsal 3x12min, Thu 70min aerobic, Fri/Sat sharpen, Sun Monza HM as a training race. Weekend mountain back-to-back moves to Wk5.
flags: Tuesday decides race pace: if 4:40/km costs over 174bpm by rep 2, race at 4:45-4:50.
Race kit locked: road shoes already tested over 15km, no new gels.
Monday 5 Oct stays rest; Wk4 Tue session gated on HRV after the race.
